Maize.t: Dry to 13% moisture (kernels crack, not dent, when bitten). Store in airtight hermetic bags raised off the floor.
steps: Dry grain to 13% moisture
Shell and winnow out broken grains
Seal in hermetic bags and stack on pallets away from walls
Maize.avoid: Storing damp grain in polythene sacks
Maize.signs: Powdery dust, tiny holes in kernels, musty smell

Local Rice.t: Dry paddy to 14%, store in clean sacks on pallets, and keep away from walls to stop weevils.
steps: Dry paddy to 14% moisture
Clean out husks, stones and chaff
Stack sacks on pallets, 50 cm from walls
Local Rice.avoid: Mixing new paddy with old stock

Yam.t: Cure tubers in the sun for a day, store on racks in a ventilated barn, and check weekly for rot.
steps: Cure tubers in the sun for one day
Tie to a vertical barn or lay on racks
Check weekly and remove rotting tubers
Yam.avoid: Piling yams on bare, wet ground

Tomatoes.t: Harvest at pink stage, keep in shade, stack crates no more than 4 high, keep away from ripe fruit.
steps: Harvest at the pink stage in the early morning
Sort out cracked or soft fruit
Keep in shade or a cold room, stacked 4 crates high at most
Tomatoes.avoid: Packing in sacks or baskets that crush the fruit
Tomatoes.signs: Wrinkled skin, water-soaked spots, fruit flies

Pepper.t: Sun-dry on raised mats away from dust, turn twice a day, bag only when brittle.
steps: Sort ripe pods from unripe ones
Sun-dry on raised mats, turning twice a day
Bag only when brittle and store dry
Pepper.avoid: Drying directly on the ground or tarmac

Onions.t: Cure 2 weeks in shade until necks dry, then store in slatted crates with good airflow.
steps: Stop watering 2 weeks before harvest
Cure 10–14 days in shade until the necks dry
Store in single layers with good airflow

Cassava.t: Process within 48 hours of harvest, or turn into gari or dried chips for long storage.
Cassava.cond: Process within 48 hours, then keep dry
Cassava.box: Gari sacks or sealed bags of dried chips
steps: Harvest only what you can process in 2 days
Peel and grate then ferment, or slice and sun-dry
Roast gari or bag dried chips in sealed sacks
Cassava.avoid: Leaving roots in the sun after harvest

Plantain.t: Harvest at full green, hang or lay single layer in shade, never refrigerate.
steps: Harvest at full green
Hang bunches or lay in a single layer
Keep away from ripe fruit
Plantain.avoid: Refrigerating plantain, which blackens the peel

Groundnut.t: Dry pods fully, shell only when selling, and store in sealed bags to avoid aflatoxin.
steps: Dry pods fully in the sun to 7–10% moisture
Remove damaged and mouldy pods
Store unshelled in sealed bags on pallets
Groundnut.avoid: Storing damp pods, which causes aflatoxin
Groundnut.signs: Mouldy smell, shrivelled or discoloured kernels
